articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show step-function improvements in graduate-level math, scientific reasoning, and long-document synthesis, positioning it as the most capable frontier model to date.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves New State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Tasks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with dramatically improved autonomous software engineering capabilities, scoring over 60% on the SWE-Bench Verified benchmark in a fully agentic setup. The model demonstrates the ability to plan multi-file refactors, write tests, and iteratively debug — raising the bar for AI-assisted development workflows.

articles.title: Figure AI Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid Robots in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure AI announced its first large-scale commercial deployment, placing Figure 03 humanoid robots on BMW assembly lines in Spartanburg, South Carolina. The robots handle bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection using on-board vision-language models, marking a significant milestone in general-purpose humanoid robotics moving from demos to production.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid performing unscripted household tasks including folding laundry, loading a dishwasher, and navigating cluttered rooms without human teleoperation. The demo highlighted a new transformer-based whole-body control policy trained in simulation and fine-tuned with real-world teleoperation data, though experts note reliability in uncontrolled environments remains an open challenge.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration for Enterprise Multi-Agent Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise platform layer allowing Claude models to orchestrate multi-agent pipelines with structured tool use, memory persistence, and human-in-the-loop approval gates. The system is designed for complex enterprise workflows like regulatory compliance review and supply chain optimization, reflecting the industry's shift from single-prompt interactions to sustained agentic systems.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its N1.4 process node has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Kaohsiung fab, several months ahead of the original timeline. The node delivers approximately 20% performance gains and 30% power efficiency improvements over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from Nvidia, AMD, and Apple beginning in early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained fault-tolerant operations on logical qubits with error rates below the threshold needed for practical quantum error correction, using their hybrid trapped-ion architecture. While a general-purpose quantum computer remains years away, this milestone substantially de-risks the path to useful quantum advantage in materials science and cryptography.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Phase Begins with First Wave of High-Risk System Audits
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting high-risk AI systems deployed in hiring, credit scoring, and law enforcement across member states. Several major U.S. tech companies have disclosed significant engineering investments to meet transparency and documentation requirements, signaling that the regulation is already reshaping global AI development practices.
